---
title: "Observing network"
---

```{python}
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '..')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import Markdown
from flagweather.config import SNOTEL
from flagweather.figures.style import BLUE, INK, MUTED, ORANGE, SURF, clean
from flagweather.sources import gauges, snotel

net = gauges.network()
sno = snotel.stations(list(SNOTEL))
asof = pd.Timestamp(net.latest.max()).tz_convert('America/Phoenix')
Markdown(f'Rolling totals as of {asof:%b %d, %Y %H:%M} MST.')
```

## City of Flagstaff rain gauges

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "City ALERT rain gauges (circles, area proportional to 30-day total), SNOTEL sites (triangles) and the Flagstaff airport (square)."
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 7.5), facecolor=SURF)
ax.scatter(net.lon, net.lat, s=net.last_P30D.fillna(0) * 25, color=BLUE, alpha=0.6, edgecolor=SURF, lw=1)
for _, r in net.dropna(subset=['last_P30D']).iterrows():
    ax.annotate(f'{r.last_P30D:.1f}', (r.lon, r.lat), fontsize=7, color=INK, ha='center', va='center')
ax.scatter(sno.lon, sno.lat, marker='^', s=90, color=ORANGE, edgecolor=INK, lw=0.6, zorder=3)
for t, r in sno.iterrows():
    ax.annotate(r['name'], (r.lon, r.lat), xytext=(6, 4), textcoords='offset points', fontsize=8.5, color=INK)
ax.scatter([-111.666], [35.144], marker='s', s=60, color=INK, zorder=3)
ax.annotate('Airport', (-111.666, 35.144), xytext=(6, -10), textcoords='offset points', fontsize=8.5, color=INK)
ax.set_aspect(1 / 0.818)
ax.set_xlabel('Longitude')
ax.set_ylabel('Latitude')
ax.set_title('30-day rain total (in) at each city gauge', loc='left', color=INK)
clean(ax)
plt.show()
```

```{python}
t = net[['site', 'owner', 'lat', 'lon', 'last_P1D', 'last_P7D', 'last_P30D']].sort_values('site')
t.columns = ['Site', 'Owner', 'Lat', 'Lon', '1-day (in)', '7-day (in)', '30-day (in)']
Markdown(t.round({'Lat': 3, 'Lon': 3, '1-day (in)': 2, '7-day (in)': 2, '30-day (in)': 2}).to_markdown(index=False))
```

The gauges are 1-mm tipping buckets operated for flood warning. Rolling totals are provisional and are not quality controlled.

## SNOTEL sites

```{python}
s = sno.reset_index()[['name', 'triplet', 'lat', 'lon', 'elev_ft', 'begin']]
s.columns = ['Site', 'Station', 'Lat', 'Lon', 'Elevation (ft)', 'Record begins']
Markdown(s.to_markdown(index=False))
```

## Flagstaff airport

NWS Flagstaff Pulliam Airport (35.144°N, 111.666°W), threaded record from RCC-ACIS, used for monthly temperature and precipitation against 1991–2020 normals.
